status: adopted for the CAIRN freeze; ratified by the user's commit and freeze (gate 4); certified by rule R-H (closure/evidence/sim_conf) and to be re-certified on human anchors by rule R-J
design: Pooled E4 + E5 lock; NH1 = T1 AND T2 on the likelihood-ratio statistic; closed testing of E4 and E5; NH2-NH5 descriptive

hypotheses.H_pool: no moment effect in E4 or E5
hypotheses.procedure: reject H_pool at alpha; only then test H_E4 and H_E5 each at alpha (closed testing; strong FWER .05)

statistic_definition: full-data conditional log-likelihood gain of CAIRN-linear over IRT-M2 (same variance components, Laplace-EM on IRT-M2), moment terms from leave-one-learner-out (regime A) references
fallback_statistic: CV (person-balanced held-out item log-loss gain, R = 10 x 5-fold), used only if the user does not ratify LR; certified in rule R-H

nulls.T1: learner-block Freedman-Lane (whole learners' moment blocks exchanged within experiment x tested-video pattern)
nulls.T2: relocation of distinct anchor moments within video (one permutation for all learners)
nulls.T2c: circular shift >= 30 s per video (sensitivity, not part of NH1)

moment_block.centring: within learner x video over the cell's anchorable items, then within item (training rows); scaled on training rows

temporal_control: Legendre polynomial of degree 3 removed from each per-second channel over the recording's own seconds before anchored pooling (mean kept); estimand = effect of anchored engagement's deviation from the learner's own cubic course
kernel_selection: development: simplest kernel within one SE of the best repetition-level CV S_item (plan §12.4); frozen into development_selections

usefulness.disclosure: CV S_item of P6 is biased downward under the null (about -.006 pooled at d = 3)

stop_rule.go: CV T2 p < .10 AND CV dAUC_wp >= .01 AND Stage-0 construct check (met)

nh4_attribution.test: gaze block (logdens, rho5, sacc, disp5) conditional on the in-window validity term held at the true anchors; LR statistic; T1lr AND T2lr; B = 999
nh4_attribution.role: descriptive secondary (NH4 attribution); licenses claims of behaviour beyond data loss
nh4_attribution.certified_by: rule R-I (closure/evidence/sim_nh4): <= .062 under N4, N0, N3 in pooled, E4, development

certification.to_recertify: rule R-J on the frozen human anchors before the CAIRN freeze
